values.en: Given a path $p$ from $x_0$ to $x_1$, this **constructs** the change-of-basepoint isomorphism $\beta^{\mathrm{con}}_p\colon\pi_1(X,x_0)\to\pi_1(X,x_1)$, $[f]\mapsto[p\cdot f\cdot\overline{p}]$, as an actual object rather than merely asserting that one exists. It is the data-level counterpart of the theorem Entry `FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath` (Hatcher Proposition 1.5, p. 28), and mirrors Mathlib's `def fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath`, which lives in a `noncomputable section`.
values.zh-CN: 给定从 $x_0$ 到 $x_1$ 的道路 $p$，本条目**构造**基点变换同构 $\beta^{\mathrm{con}}_p\colon\pi_1(X,x_0)\to\pi_1(X,x_1)$，$[f]\mapsto[p\cdot f\cdot\overline{p}]$，给出的是对象本身而不只是断言其存在。它是定理条目 `FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath` 的数据层对应物（Hatcher 命题 1.5，第 28 页），对应 Mathlib 的 `def fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath`，后者位于 `noncomputable section` 中。
